episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's canine sign-on before Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple tackled chat news including Pete Hegseth's travel budget leverage and JD Vance's Trump shoe-size penis anecdote. Hype Train derailed acknowledgments into a slime-sheet freestyle, then Chet and ChetAI commandeered the broadcast for Chinese robot verification and a Kohler smart-toilet encryption exposé. Case spent 20 minutes live-prompting Gemini to generate bob haircut variants for remote girlfriend Kendelle. The Munch & Crum debate descended into AI baby-photo forensics, with chat crowning Munch cuter and dubbing Crum a toilet baby. Rick closed with a low-scoring Amongst the Web before raiding Miss Gina Darling and confirming next week's Grinch stream.
